description: AGSC-01-23. Derivation, case by case. (1) Two incoming files that slugify alike are the collision the rule has always described: the second is suffixed `-2`, in discovery order. (2) An incoming item whose slug the TARGET Bundle already holds with DIFFERENT content is not a slug collision and is never suffixed — suffixing it would break this rule's own idempotence — so the import writes nothing at all, reports AGSC-E206 for every such path and exits non-zero; `--dry-run` reports the same. (3) A planned path whose bytes are already exactly what the import would write is unchanged and is not a collision, which is what keeps a re-run idempotent. An engine that silently replaces the operator's own item and reports `1 written`, exit 0, no finding, fails this case.
